property_summary: For any admissible play, whenever play() completes successfully the recorded pot can never exceed the Ether actually held by the contract (pot <= address(c).balance), since only the ticket value is deposited; the mutant records 2x the ticket in pot, so after a losing roll pot (20) exceeds the contract balance (10).
change_summary: Change pot accumulation to add twice the ticket value, so pot differs after a losing play.
